title: Can You Drink Too Much Water?

scenes.text: Is it possible to drink too much water? Discover the answer!

scenes.label: MYTH: More Water is Always Better

scenes.text: Some people believe you can never drink too much water.
scenes.label: MYTH: Overhydration Isn’t Real

scenes.text: In reality, drinking excessive amounts of water can lead to a dangerous condition known as hyponatremia.
scenes.label: TRUTH: Too Much Water Can be Harmful
ON-SCREEN TAKEAWAY: Balance is Key
scenes.sub: Hydration is essential but needs balance.
